name: Repair broken H3 prompt and answer beginner voiceover question
prompt: Fix this broken 6s MiniMax H3 prompt and tell me how to write an off-screen voiceover: '[00.00s-3.0s]: [VISUAL]: [Shot 1] <Subject 1>'s coat moves as they walk. [SPEECH]: None. [3.5s-06.00s]: [VISUAL]: [Shot 2] Both hands open the door.'

judge.check: Repaired prompt fixes field envelope, timestamp zero-padding/gap, <Subject 1>'s possessive, 'they'/'Both' pronouns, over-cut [Shot 2] if continuous, and omits [SPEECH]: None.
Explains off-screen voiceover syntax ('says in an off-screen voiceover <d>[Lang] ...</d>' plus stating lips remain closed) clearly.
